spark: Faelor gave false witness at a lord's court for a purse of silver, and an innocent smith was hanged on his word

focal.name: Faelor
focal.who: An elf with a fine voice who no longer sings.
focal.backstory: Faelor was the court singer at a river lord's hall when a smith stood accused of theft. Paid by the real thief, he swore he saw the smith do it, and the smith was hanged.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
